newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to tackle securities markets reform soon.
newsitem.headline: Spain to tackle securities markets reform soon.

text.p: Spain said on Thursday a reform of its securities markets was imminent as part of a plan to adapt to European union laws and ensure future growth.

Deputy prime minister Rodrigo Rato said the government intended to adopt the necessary measures to deregulate and liberalise Spain's securities markets before integration into a single financial market.
"We must take advantage of the favourable state of the economy to put reforms into action which guarantee future growth," Rato told a conference in Barcelona.
The Economy Ministry said the reforms, which will open Spanish markets to EU competition, would hopefully improve the competitiveness of Spanish intermediaries and reduce operating costs.
